title: Publish draft app to production

requirements.text: Publish the current draft version (Version 9) to production with a permanent URL accessible to all users
acceptanceCriteria: Draft Version 9 is deployed to production environment
App is accessible via a permanent production URL
All features from Version 9 are working in production
Production deployment is stable and accessible to end users

constraints: Use existing draft code without modifications
Preserve all current features and functionality from Version 9
nonGoals: Making any code changes or feature updates
